jobs.title: Lead Auditor
jobs.reason: Pure mismatch — ISO compliance auditing (quality, environmental, OH&S management systems) is unrelated to IR, policy, or intelligence work. The role mandates certified Lead Auditor credentials for ISO 9001/14001/45001 which the candidate does not hold, and "Senior Lead" framing implies substantial prior auditing experience.

jobs.title: Senior BI Analyst Developer
jobs.reason: This is a senior Power BI developer role requiring 5+ years of specialist BI development experience, deep Power BI/DAX/SQL/Azure DevOps expertise, and technical leadership — none of which match the candidate's IR research profile. Hard ineligibility triggered on the 5+ years requirement and on specialist technical skills the candidate cannot substitute for.

jobs.title: Researcher
jobs.reason: Control Risks is a core target firm in commercial intelligence and geopolitical risk — a direct fit for zone (b). A Researcher title typically maps to a junior/early-career analyst level suited to the candidate's MSc-in-progress and substantial research-assistant experience. Note: the job description provided is minimal, so specific skill/seniority requirements could not be fully verified.

jobs.title: Embedded Intelligence Program Manager
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent — Sibylline is a core target employer in commercial intelligence. However, the role hard-requires 5–7+ years of relevant experience plus 3–5 years of management experience, triggering the hard ineligibility rule on years of experience and seniority (Program Manager / team lead level).

jobs.title: Fachhandwerkerin/Fachhandwerker (w/m/d) im Referat – Gebäudetechnik
jobs.reason: This is a skilled-trades position in building services (sanitary, heating, water and gas systems) requiring a completed German vocational training (Ausbildung) as Anlagenmechaniker SHK or equivalent, plus several years of relevant hands-on experience and certified physical fitness for working at heights. Hard ineligibility triggered: candidate lacks the required vocational training and technical trade skills, and the role is entirely outside the IR/policy/research field.
jobs.salary: €3,682.69 gross/month (experience level 3) + €220 ministerial allowance (TVöD E7 / A7)

jobs.title: Embedded Travel Security Specialist
jobs.reason: Sibylline is a core target organisation and the role draws on geopolitical risk and OSINT — directly aligned with the candidate's zone (b) targets. However, the role asks for at least three years of specific travel security/risk management experience plus familiarity with travel risk frameworks, which the candidate lacks; their experience is in academic research rather than operational security delivery.
jobs.location: London, UK (hybrid, 3 days/week in client office)

jobs.title: Studentische Hilfskraft (d/m/w) in der Forschungsgruppe EU/Europa
jobs.reason: SWP is Germany's leading foreign-policy think-tank and the EU/Europa research group aligns directly with the candidate's IR focus and Franco-German/European interests. The profile (advanced social sciences study, native German + strong English, research and event-organisation experience) matches the candidate's CV precisely, and the student-assistant level fits their stage.
jobs.type: Part-time (10 hours/week), fixed-term 1 year with option to extend

jobs.title: Wissenschaftler:in (d/m/w) für das Projekt „Volumetrisches Imperium: Autonomie und Abhängigkeit im Export chinesischer Weltraum-infrastruktur"
jobs.reason: Field is broadly relevant (IR/IPE doctoral research at a top German policy institute), but the project demands deep China expertise, fieldwork in China and Ethiopia, and preferably fluent Mandarin — none of which the candidate has. The role is a PhD position requiring a specialised China/Africa background and lexicometric methods, which is a significant mismatch with the candidate's profile despite the MSc-level entry point.
jobs.salary: TVöD Bund up to E13 (pro-rated to 75%)

jobs.title: Head of School of Computer Science and Engineering
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility on multiple grounds: the role explicitly requires a PhD, is a senior leadership appointment at Associate Professor/Professor level, and is in computer science and engineering — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy field. Not a viable target on any dimension.
